# Outline

Question (Sarah, 2026-11-17): is there a succession of signatures that **appear in
background seawater, increase in the plume, and persist at the vent**?

Non-vent splits into 3 background units (Gorda Ridge BSW, Piccard, Von Damm) and 3 plume
units (Gorda Ridge [2 replicates averaged], Piccard, Von Damm): one of each per field, so
every plume-vs-background comparison is **paired by field**.

Three readouts, at two levels (community = KO; lineage = class-level taxon x KO pair):

1. **Zone patterns.** Each vent-associated feature is placed by where else it is
   detected: vent only, plume + vent, background + vent, or all three zones.
   _Emergence in the plume_ = more plume + vent features than background + vent features.
2. **Increase.** Among features detected in all three zones, the share of features whose
   expression share is higher in plume than in background **in every field**, and how many
   of those also sit at or above the plume level at vents.
3. **Community distance.** Per field, Aitchison (rCLR + Euclidean) distance from the plume
   unit and from the background unit to the field's vent units. Succession predicts
   plume closer to vent than background is, in all three fields.

**Null (the only honest one at n = 3 + 3).** Swap the plume and background labels within
fields. There are 2^3 = 8 labelings (the real one included); every statistic is recomputed
for each. The real labeling can rank at best 1 of 8 (p = 0.125), so this is a consistency
check, not a significance test. Per-field agreement (3 of 3 fields) is the replication.

**Depth.** Plume units are shallower than background in 2 of 3 fields (KOs detected:
plume 1,524 / 2,498 / 3,567; background 1,597 / 4,068 / 4,499; `05_depth_check.csv`).
Detection-based readouts are run under three schemes:

* `none`: no subsampling.
* `pair_matched` (primary): within each field, the plume and background units are both
  subsampled to the shallower of the two; vent units untouched. This equalises effort for
  the plume-vs-background contrast that the question turns on.
* `nonvent_to_vent`: as in 08, each non-vent unit subsampled to a depth drawn from the 13
  vent unit depths.

Share-based readouts (2 and 3) use unsubsampled expression.

# Set up

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R")
```

```{r params}
FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard")
CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4
MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm                 # 1
MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million # 10
VENT_MIN_UNITS <- params$vent_min_units          # 05 rule (2026-11-23): >= 3 of 13 vent units
ZONE_MIN_SWEEP <- c(1, 2)                        # plume / background presence: >= 1 or >= 2 of 3 units

N_DRAWS <- 100
SCHEMES <- c("none", "pair_matched", "nonvent_to_vent")
ZONES <- c("background", "plume", "vent")
PREV_MIN <- 4      # units a KO must be detected in for the rCLR matrix

PANEL_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/gene_candidates_central.csv" # 00c
TAXON_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_taxon_habitat.csv"          # 05
```

```{r data}
#| message: true
paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH)

# zone from the unit name: "<field>_Non-vent_<site>"; BSW counts as background
zone_of <- function(unit, vent_bin) {
  factor(case_when(vent_bin == "Vent"            ~ "vent",
                   str_detect(unit, "_Plume$")   ~ "plume",
                   TRUE                          ~ "background"), levels = ZONES)
}

units <- paired |>
  distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field) |>
  mutate(zone = zone_of(unit, vent_bin)) |>
  arrange(zone, field, unit)
units |> count(zone, field)
stopifnot(
  sum(units$zone == "vent") == 13,
  all(count(filter(units, zone != "vent"), field, zone)$n == 1))   # one plume + one background per field

pair_unit <- unit_expression(paired, c("cur_L4", "ko_id"), MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION)
ko_unit   <- unit_expression(paired, "ko_id", MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION)
rm(paired)

panel_kos <- read_csv(PANEL_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(subcategory), status != "unresolved", match_type == "ko") |>
  distinct(feature_id) |>
  pull(feature_id)

tax_hab <- read_csv(TAXON_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(cur_L4, taxon_habitat = habitat_class)

vent_min <- VENT_MIN_UNITS   # 3 (was 4 under the 30% rule)
# 05's vent-only (no background detection, plume allowed) = this script's vent_only + plume_vent
```

# Labelings: the real one and the 7 within-field swaps

```{r labelings}
nonvent_units <- units |> filter(zone != "vent")

# swap = TRUE flips plume <-> background in that field
labelings <- expand_grid(!!!set_names(rep(list(c(FALSE, TRUE)), length(FIELDS_IN_SCOPE)),
                                      FIELDS_IN_SCOPE)) |>
  mutate(labeling = row_number(), real = if_all(all_of(FIELDS_IN_SCOPE), \(x) !x)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(FIELDS_IN_SCOPE), names_to = "field", values_to = "swap")

relabel <- function(lab_id) {
  sw <- labelings |> filter(labeling == lab_id)
  units |>
    left_join(select(sw, field, swap), by = "field") |>
    mutate(zone = case_when(zone == "vent" ~ "vent",
                            swap & zone == "plume" ~ "background",
                            swap & zone == "background" ~ "plume",
                            TRUE ~ as.character(zone)),
           zone = factor(zone, levels = ZONES)) |>
    select(unit, field, zone)
}
stopifnot(n_distinct(labelings$labeling) == 8, sum(distinct(labelings, labeling, real)$real) == 1)
```

# 1. Zone patterns (emergence)

```{r patterns}
count_by_zone <- function(det, unit_zone, by) {
  det |>
    filter(detected) |>
    inner_join(unit_zone, by = "unit") |>
    count(across(all_of(c(by, "zone"))), name = "n_det") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = n_det, names_prefix = "n_", values_fill = 0) |>
    (\(x) { for (z in paste0("n_", ZONES)) if (!z %in% names(x)) x[[z]] <- 0L; x })()
}

zone_pattern <- function(n_background, n_plume, n_vent, zone_min) {
  in_b <- n_background >= zone_min
  in_p <- n_plume >= zone_min
  in_v <- n_vent >= vent_min
  factor(case_when(
    in_v & n_background == 0 & n_plume == 0 ~ "vent_only",
    in_v & in_p & n_background == 0         ~ "plume_vent",
    in_v & in_b & n_plume == 0              ~ "background_vent",
    in_v & in_p & in_b                      ~ "all_three",
    in_v                                    ~ "vent_plus_sparse",   # non-vent detections below zone_min
    in_p & n_background == 0 & n_vent == 0  ~ "plume_only",
    in_b & n_plume == 0 & n_vent == 0       ~ "background_only",
    in_p | in_b                             ~ "nonvent_other",
    TRUE                                    ~ "below_filter"),
    levels = c("vent_only", "plume_vent", "all_three", "background_vent", "vent_plus_sparse",
               "plume_only", "background_only", "nonvent_other", "below_filter"))
}

# emergence summary for one detection table x one labeling x one zone rule
emergence <- function(counts, zone_min, panel = NULL) {
  pat <- counts |>
    mutate(pattern = zone_pattern(n_background, n_plume, n_vent, zone_min))
  if (!is.null(panel)) pat <- filter(pat, ko_id %in% panel)
  n_pv <- sum(pat$pattern == "plume_vent")
  n_bv <- sum(pat$pattern == "background_vent")
  list(patterns = count(pat, pattern, .drop = FALSE),
       stat = tibble(n_plume_vent = n_pv, n_background_vent = n_bv,
                     plume_bias = n_pv / (n_pv + n_bv)))   # 0.5 = no asymmetry
}
```

## Subsampling (helpers from 08)

```{r subsample}
pair_counts <- pair_unit |>
  transmute(unit, vent_bin, field, cur_L4, ko_id, count = as.integer(floor(tpm))) |>   # floor: as 08
  filter(count > 0)
unit_depth <- pair_counts |>
  summarise(depth = sum(count), .by = c(unit, vent_bin, field)) |>
  mutate(zone = zone_of(unit, vent_bin))
vent_depths <- unit_depth$depth[unit_depth$zone == "vent"]
unit_ref <- pair_unit |>
  distinct(unit, unit_total_05 = unit_total) |>
  left_join(select(unit_depth, unit, depth), by = "unit")

subsample_counts <- function(counts, depth) {
  if (depth >= sum(counts)) return(counts)
  tabulate(sample(rep.int(seq_along(counts), counts), depth), nbins = length(counts))
}

draw_targets <- function(scheme) {
  d <- mutate(unit_depth, target = depth)
  if (scheme == "pair_matched")
    d <- d |> mutate(target = if_else(zone == "vent", depth, min(depth[zone != "vent"])),
                     .by = field)
  if (scheme == "nonvent_to_vent") {
    nv <- d$zone != "vent"
    d$target[nv] <- pmin(d$depth[nv], sample(vent_depths, sum(nv)))
  }
  d
}

subsample_table <- function(scheme) {
  if (scheme == "none") return(pair_counts)
  pair_counts |>
    left_join(select(draw_targets(scheme), unit, target), by = "unit") |>
    mutate(count = subsample_counts(count, first(target)), .by = unit) |>
    filter(count > 0) |>
    select(-target)
}

# same rule and denominator as 08 (05's unit total scaled by the share of counts kept)
detect_counts <- function(sub, by) {
  kept <- sub |>
    summarise(unit_total = sum(count), .by = unit) |>
    left_join(unit_ref, by = "unit") |>
    mutate(denom = unit_total_05 * unit_total / depth) |>
    select(unit, unit_total, denom)
  sub |>
    summarise(count = sum(count), .by = all_of(c("unit", by))) |>
    left_join(kept, by = "unit") |>
    mutate(detected = count >= MIN_TPM & count / denom * 1e6 >= MIN_PER_MILLION) |>
    select(-denom)
}
```

```{r run-emergence}
#| message: true
runs <- expand_grid(scheme = SCHEMES, draw = seq_len(N_DRAWS)) |>
  filter(scheme != "none" | draw == 1)
unit_zones <- map(set_names(1:8), relabel)

set.seed(params$seed)
t0 <- Sys.time()
emerge <- pmap(runs, \(scheme, draw) {
  det <- if (scheme == "none") {
    list(KO = ko_unit, pair = pair_unit)        # unsubsampled: the 05 detections exactly
  } else {
    sub <- subsample_table(scheme)
    list(KO = detect_counts(sub, "ko_id"), pair = detect_counts(sub, c("cur_L4", "ko_id")))
  }
  out <- expand_grid(labeling = 1:8, level = c("KO", "KO_panel", "pair"), zone_min = ZONE_MIN_SWEEP) |>
    pmap(\(labeling, level, zone_min) {
      by  <- if (level == "pair") c("cur_L4", "ko_id") else "ko_id"
      tab <- if (level == "pair") det$pair else det$KO
      cnt <- count_by_zone(tab, unit_zones[[labeling]], by)
      e   <- emergence(cnt, zone_min, panel = if (level == "KO_panel") panel_kos else NULL)
      key <- tibble(scheme = scheme, draw = draw, labeling = labeling, level = level, zone_min = zone_min)
      list(stat = bind_cols(key, e$stat), patterns = bind_cols(key, e$patterns),
           pairs = if (level == "pair" && labeling == 1 && scheme == "none")
             mutate(cnt, pattern = zone_pattern(n_background, n_plume, n_vent, zone_min),
                    zone_min = zone_min) else NULL)
    })
  list_transpose(out) |> map(bind_rows)
}) |> list_transpose() |> map(bind_rows)
message(glue("{nrow(runs)} draws x 8 labelings in ",
             "{round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'mins'), 1)} min"))

emerge$stat <- emerge$stat |>
  left_join(distinct(labelings, labeling, real), by = "labeling")
```

## Emergence: plume + vent vs background + vent

```{r emergence-summary}
q <- \(x, p) unname(quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE))

emergence_summary <- emerge$stat |>
  summarise(across(c(n_plume_vent, n_background_vent, plume_bias),
                   list(med = median, lo = \(x) q(x, 0.025), hi = \(x) q(x, 0.975))),
            .by = c(scheme, level, zone_min, labeling, real)) |>
  # rank of the real labeling among the 8 (1 = strongest plume bias)
  mutate(rank_of_8 = rank(-plume_bias_med, ties.method = "max"),
         .by = c(scheme, level, zone_min))

emergence_summary |>
  filter(real) |>
  select(scheme, level, zone_min, n_plume_vent_med, n_background_vent_med,
         plume_bias_med, plume_bias_lo, plume_bias_hi, rank_of_8) |>
  arrange(level, zone_min, scheme)
```

> For results: succession predicts `plume_bias` > 0.5 under `pair_matched`, with an
> interval above 0.5 and the real labeling ranked 1 of 8. Labeling 8 (all fields
> swapped) is the mirror image, so it should rank last.

```{r fig-patterns}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
fig_patterns <- emerge$patterns |>
  filter(labeling == 1, zone_min == 1, level != "KO_panel",
         pattern %in% c("vent_only", "plume_vent", "all_three", "background_vent")) |>
  summarise(n = median(n), .by = c(scheme, level, pattern)) |>
  ggplot(aes(pattern, n, fill = scheme)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ level, scales = "free_y", labeller = as_labeller(c(KO = "KOs", pair = "Lineage x KO pairs"))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(none = "grey60", pair_matched = "#b74a70", nonvent_to_vent = "#3b6ea5")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Vent-associated features (median of draws)", fill = "Depth scheme") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
fig_patterns
```

## Which lineages carry the plume + vent pairs

Unsubsampled, real labeling.

```{r bridge-lineages}
bridge_lineages <- emerge$pairs |>
  filter(pattern %in% c("plume_vent", "background_vent", "all_three")) |>
  count(zone_min, cur_L4, pattern) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = pattern, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  left_join(tax_hab, by = "cur_L4") |>
  arrange(zone_min, desc(plume_vent))
bridge_lineages |> filter(zone_min == 1) |> slice_head(n = 20)
```

# 2. Increase: higher in plume than background, persisting at vents

Unsubsampled shares. For features detected in all three zones (pattern `all_three`,
zone_min = 1), per field: `plume > background` share. Vent level = median share over the
13 vent units (zeros included).

```{r increase}
share_by_zone <- function(ue, by, unit_zone) {
  ue |>
    select(all_of(c("unit", by, "share"))) |>
    complete(unit = units$unit, nesting(!!!rlang::syms(by)), fill = list(share = 0)) |>
    inner_join(unit_zone, by = "unit")
}

increase_stats <- function(ue, by, unit_zone, keep) {
  sz <- share_by_zone(semi_join(ue, keep, by = by), by, unit_zone)
  nv <- sz |>
    filter(zone != "vent") |>
    select(-unit) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = share) |>
    summarise(n_fields_up = sum(plume > background),
              plume_mean  = mean(plume), background_mean = mean(background),
              .by = all_of(by))
  vt <- sz |> filter(zone == "vent") |>
    summarise(vent_median = median(share), .by = all_of(by))
  nv |>
    left_join(vt, by = by) |>
    mutate(succession = n_fields_up == 3 & vent_median >= plume_mean)
}

increase_runs <- expand_grid(labeling = 1:8, level = c("KO", "pair")) |>
  pmap(\(labeling, level) {
    by  <- if (level == "pair") c("cur_L4", "ko_id") else "ko_id"
    ue  <- if (level == "pair") pair_unit else ko_unit
    # all-three set fixed from the real labeling (it does not depend on the swap)
    keep <- count_by_zone(ue, unit_zones[[1]], by) |>
      filter(zone_pattern(n_background, n_plume, n_vent, 1) == "all_three") |>
      select(all_of(by))
    st <- increase_stats(ue, by, unit_zones[[labeling]], keep)
    list(summary = tibble(labeling = labeling, level = level, n_all_three = nrow(st),
                          n_up_3of3 = sum(st$n_fields_up == 3),
                          n_down_3of3 = sum(st$n_fields_up == 0),
                          n_succession = sum(st$succession),
                          n_succession_panel = if (level == "KO")
                            sum(st$succession & st$ko_id %in% panel_kos) else NA_integer_),
         features = if (labeling == 1) mutate(st, level = level) else NULL)
  }) |>
  list_transpose() |>
  map(bind_rows)

increase_summary <- increase_runs$summary |>
  left_join(distinct(labelings, labeling, real), by = "labeling") |>
  mutate(rank_of_8 = rank(-n_succession, ties.method = "max"), .by = level)
increase_summary |> arrange(level, labeling)
```

> For results: under no field-consistent plume effect, `n_up_3of3` and `n_down_3of3`
> are similar (each field is a coin flip, so ~1/8 of features land in each). Succession
> = `n_up_3of3` clearly above `n_down_3of3`, and the real labeling at rank 1.

# 3. Community distance: is plume closer to vent than background is?

rCLR (`vegan::decostand(method = "rclr")`) on unit x KO shares, Euclidean distance
(Aitchison). Per field: mean distance from the plume unit, and from the background unit,
to that field's vent units, and to all 13 vent units.

```{r distance}
ko_mat <- ko_unit |>
  filter(detected) |>
  select(unit, ko_id, tpm) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = ko_id, values_from = tpm, values_fill = 0) |>
  column_to_rownames("unit") |>
  as.matrix()
ko_mat <- ko_mat[, colSums(ko_mat > 0) >= PREV_MIN, drop = FALSE]   # as prevalence_filter(..., 4)
aitch <- as.matrix(dist(vegan::decostand(ko_mat, method = "rclr")))

dist_to_vent <- units |>
  filter(zone != "vent") |>
  mutate(
    d_vent_same_field = map2_dbl(unit, field, \(u, f)
      mean(aitch[u, units$unit[units$zone == "vent" & units$field == f]])),
    d_vent_all = map_dbl(unit, \(u) mean(aitch[u, units$unit[units$zone == "vent"]]))) |>
  select(field, zone, d_vent_same_field, d_vent_all) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = zone, values_from = c(d_vent_same_field, d_vent_all)) |>
  mutate(plume_closer_same = d_vent_same_field_plume < d_vent_same_field_background,
         plume_closer_all  = d_vent_all_plume < d_vent_all_background)
dist_to_vent
```

> For results: succession predicts `plume_closer_*` TRUE in all three fields. Depth caveat:
> rCLR distances are not rarefied here; if plume closeness tracks depth rather than zone,
> rerun on a `pair_matched` subsample (one draw is enough for a check).

# QC

```{r qc}
stopifnot(
  # each labeling keeps 3 plume + 3 background units, one per field
  all(map_lgl(unit_zones, \(uz) all(count(filter(uz, zone != "vent"), field, zone)$n == 1))),
  # the all-swapped labeling mirrors the real one at every level and rule (unsubsampled)
  emerge$stat |> filter(scheme == "none") |>
    select(level, zone_min, labeling, n_plume_vent, n_background_vent) |>
    (\(s) { r <- filter(s, labeling == 1); m <- filter(s, labeling == 8)
            all(r$n_plume_vent == m$n_background_vent) })(),
  # vents are never subsampled under pair_matched
  all(draw_targets("pair_matched") |> filter(zone == "vent") |> with(target == depth)),
  # pair_matched gives equal targets to plume and background within each field
  draw_targets("pair_matched") |> filter(zone != "vent") |>
    summarise(k = n_distinct(target), .by = field) |> with(all(k == 1)))
```
